name: jrx
description: JRX (Java + JSX): syntax highlighting and a language server (diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition).

jrx.server.jar.description: Path to jrx-lsp.jar. Empty: the jar bundled with the extension (server/jrx-lsp.jar).

jrx.javaPath.description: The java executable that runs the server (JDK 17+; javac diagnostics need a JDK, not a JRE).

jrx.sourceRoots.description: Extra folders with .java sources for javac and component lookup (relative to the workspace root). Folders inside the workspace are found automatically.

jrx.classpath.description: Jars or class folders for javac, e.g. the jreact-core jar, when its sources are not in the workspace.
